verdict.rationale: Temporal documents a self-hosted deployment path, so users can run the service on infrastructure they control and decide where workflow data lives. Its pricing page also lists "Multi-Cloud & Multi-Region" for Temporal Cloud. The evidence never explicitly describes picking a storage region or making data-residency guarantees for the SaaS offering. missing for 10: explicit Temporal Cloud region selection docs, a list of available regions, documented data-residency guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: This guide shows you how to self-host open source infrastructure software that orchestrates your durable applications.
Choose a deployment approach (Docker, Kubernetes, or manual) and set up a production-ready Temporal Service.
